name: Inflatable rex suit

hinged lower jaw with teeth, red mouth interior and tongue when open
seamed ripstop torso with belly panel, piping, legs and clawed feet
back fan housing with steel grille and an outer puffed shell option
tapered tail with ridge rings and dorsal spikes
style: Glossy olive-green ripstop inflatable dinosaur costume with lighter belly panel, seam piping, white teeth and orange claws, original shapes only.
summary: Inflatable T-rex costume kit: puffed head with hinged jaw and teeth, seamed ripstop torso and legs, stubby tail, tiny clawed arms and a back fan.
